# Popalzai Clothing Production

> Popalzai Clothing Production (PCP) is a made-to-measure clothing and uniform production company based in the UAE. We produce garments to individual measurements — no standard sizes, no minimums — for hospitality groups, independent brands, and private clients, from sample development through finished production.

PCP runs two lines of business: made-to-measure garment and uniform production, and Popalzai On-Site — master tailors sponsored, equipped, and placed full-time inside hotels on a monthly subscription. Clients can start a project online with the Sample Maker, which turns a garment concept into a sample specification.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/): Overview of PCP and what we produce
- [Services](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/services): Made-to-measure production for brands, hospitality, and private clients
- [Popalzai On-Site](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/on-site): Full-time master tailors placed inside hotels on subscription
- [Sample Maker](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/sample-maker): Pick a garment, place your artwork, and send a sample specification
- [Work](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/work): Client index
- [Process](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/process): How production works from measurement to delivery
- [FAQ](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/faq): Common questions about minimums, timelines, and production
- [About](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/about): Who we are
- [Inquiry](https://www.popalzaiproduction.com/inquiry): Start a project or request a quote
